semantics.mutation_rule: read-only projection from canonical worker memory accounting
semantics.shape_rule: the map contains active_bytes.all.current and reserved_bytes.all.current
semantics.dtype_rule: all byte counts are exact u64 values
semantics.accumulation_dtype: checked u64 accounting owned by MemoryPlacementInventory
semantics.device_rule: the capability matrix must identify NPU and the accounting snapshot must contain the exact ordinal
semantics.numeric_rule: active bytes equal accounted NPU allocations; reserved bytes equal active bytes because Zed has no separate caching allocator
semantics.determinism: immutable worker-accounting projection with sorted keys
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation and after map construction
semantics.jvp_rule: memory accounting metadata has no tangent
